title: TC/Jev stage 2 — Jev as the judge, sample bank, API TC runner

sources.locator: user decision 2026-11-16: Jev decides, LLM re-checks a share, samples kept as a bank
user decision 2026-11-16: testers get a script with code-enforced limits for API/DB/log checks

actions.title: Send an API request for a TC
actions.trigger: runs tc-api-run.js request with a tc-run.json, a session name, a method and a path
outputs: one JSON line with status, headers and body

actions.title: Read a project file for a TC
actions.trigger: runs tc-api-run.js read with a tc-run.json and a readable source name

actions.title: Record an LLM re-check of a Jev verdict
actions.trigger: runs tc-jev-judge.js audit with a sample id and the LLM verdict
preconditions: the question has a calibration entry

actions.title: Propose thresholds from the sample bank
Score TC sentences with Jev
actions.trigger: runs tc-jev-check.js on a TC file

test_cases.title: A request to the allowed origin returns the response
preconditions: tc-run.json whose base_url is that server

steps.goal: Run tc-api-run.js request with method GET and a path on the server

expected.text: The output status field is the server's status code

test_cases.title: A request to another origin is refused
preconditions: tc-run.json whose base_url is a loopback server

steps.goal: Run tc-api-run.js request with an absolute URL on another host as the path

expected.text: No request reaches the other host

test_cases.title: A login response cookie is masked in the output
preconditions: a test server whose login route sets a session cookie

steps.goal: Run tc-api-run.js request with method POST on the login route

expected.text: The cookie value does not appear in the output

test_cases.title: Reading a file outside readable is refused
preconditions: tc-run.json whose readable entry points outside the project root

steps.goal: Run tc-api-run.js read with that source name

expected.text: The file content does not appear in the output

test_cases.title: Two disagreements in the last 20 re-checks revoke the calibration
preconditions: a test Jev directory with a calibration entry for Q.holds@1

steps.goal: Record two audits where the LLM verdict differs from Jev

test_cases.title: A false PASS in the holdout split makes the calibration unsafe
preconditions: labeled samples whose holdout split has a FAIL scored 0.95

expected.text: The report status for that question is unsafe

test_cases.title: An api-channel sentence gets no jev_hidden warning
preconditions: a mock Jev that scores hidden 0.9
a TC file whose expected result uses the api channel

steps.goal: Run tc-jev-check.js on the TC file

expected.text: The warnings list has no jev_hidden entry

test_cases.title: Installing as root on Linux adds --no-sandbox

steps.goal: Build the MCP server entries the installer writes

expected.text: Every playwright-test entry has --no-sandbox in args
